    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        export: Exports the grid, as its export/ tree says.
        out/export/error.txt has no golden.

        out/export/inputs differs (-golden +got):
        - via/export/import/out/quote/A1
        -   in/export/out/import/out/quote/A1
        + error.txt

        out/export/outcome differs (-golden +got):
        - accepted
        + rejected
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
        via/export/import/out/quote/A1 is recorded, and export failed on the case in this run, so this run has no product.
        If it should make one, fix export or the case. If not, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., which removes it, and read the diff before committing.
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        import: Imports the export as a script, as its import/ tree says.
        import returned no error, but the case states unterminated, which import rejects.
        FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... blocks import: it reruns export, whose outcome and product a normal run reads from the archive, and the lift export, on import's path, failed on the case. Run it, fix what it reports, and read the diff before committing.
        via/import/quote/Z9 is a file of import's committed product, which this run of import doesn't make.
        FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... blocks import: it reruns export, whose outcome and product a normal run reads from the archive, and the lift export, on import's path, failed on the case. It removes the file: read the diff before committing.
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.

        - 1 files
        + 2 files
          quote/A1 "3\n"
        + quote/Z9 "9\n"

          files.txt

        +   via/import/quote/Z9
        FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... blocks list: it reruns export, whose outcome and product a normal run reads from the archive, and the lift export, on list's path, failed on the case. Run it, fix what it reports, and read the diff before committing.

$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-twice
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        export: Exports the grid, as its export/ tree says.
        export's jenny failed on the case, with an error that is no rejection:
          export: the generator's error
        If export rejects the case, return the error as decl.Reject(err). If not, fix export's jenny. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        import: Imports the export as a script, as its import/ tree says.
        The cell of the lift export, on import's path, has a problem, which that cell reports, in the package that owns it. A normal run reads the product and the outcome the archive commits for export, so this cell runs nothing.
        Fix what export's cell reports. An update writes nothing for the cell of the lift export, on import's path, nor for this cell.
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        list: Lists the files of the script's input view, with their bytes.
        The cell of the lift export, on list's path, has a problem, which that cell reports, in the package that owns it. A normal run reads the product and the outcome the archive commits for export, so this cell runs nothing.
        Fix what export's cell reports. An update writes nothing for the cell of the lift export, on list's path, nor for this cell.
    what ran, in order:
        export ran
